subject: planner: make group expression inherit logical plan & refine rule interface. (#57782)
summary: Refactors the (new/experimental) cascades planner memo/rule plumbing: `memo.GroupExpression` now embeds `base.LogicalPlan` (removing `MemoExpression`), binder returns matched subtrees as `base.LogicalPlan` via plan-children wiring, and the rule interface is simplified (adds `ID`/`PreCheck`, switches to buffered string writer). Within the reviewed diff and minimal callers, no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/concurrency/privilege issues were found.
